trailhead.label: Sauch, at the entrance to the Val San Nicolò (the shuttle bus stop), the sheet’s start

cautions: The shuttle bus and the road train use the asphalt road as far as the Baita Ciampiè in summer: keep your dog close when they pass.
The last 100 m to the Baita alle Cascate are steep and cobbled: take it slowly with an older dog.
Cows may graze the meadows in summer: keep a short lead and give them room.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
